title: Can I BEAT Every Christmas Bot?
summary: He plays chess.com's Christmas bots in rising order: Yeti (450, speaks Yeti with translation, holds a pawn), Gingerbread man, Santa, Holly (1800), the angry Penguin (2250, beats him and 'honks'), and finally Evil Santa (mall-Santa smirk, 'Tonight shall be the silentest of nights'), who also outplays him.
rules: Normal chess vs a ladder of six holiday bots: Yeti 450 -> Gingerbread -> Santa -> Holly 1800 -> Penguin 2250 -> Evil Santa (final boss, highest).
Bots send themed chat lines after moves (Yeti with translation; Gingerbread 'don't eat me yet'; Evil Santa creepy lines).
win_condition: Checkmate each bot in turn (he loses to Penguin and Evil Santa).

opponent.name: Evil Santa (final)
opponent.avatar_description: Yeti holding a chess pawn; gingerbread man; Santa; Holly; angry penguin; Evil Santa with evil smirk

current_impl_issues: Gauntlet mapping is right in spirit but needs the six specific holiday personas, ratings and chat; Penguin and Evil Santa should be strong (2250+).

current_impl.explain: Climb a ladder of bots: every win promotes you to a stronger one. Beat the top rung.

captured piece removed as mover lands
bot taunt e.g. 'Victory is mine. Honk honk'
